I apologize for the confusion. It was a false error.

I had to spend a lot of time debugging to find out that the real issue was the game server not responding to the Agones health check due to memory limitations. As a result, Agones killed the server instance and started a new one. After the server was killed, Godot unexpectedly triggered errors unrelated to the issue, such as "Unreferenced static string" and "Index p_index = 1 is out of bounds."

Once I removed the resource constraints for the GameServer Pod, the problem stopped happening.
